claim_verdicts.evidence: Helm 3 docs index: "Helm is the package manager for Kubernetes". Charts page (Helm 3.22 docs, v3 line): "Chart.yaml # A YAML file containing information about the chart"; "values.yaml # The default configuration values for this chart"; "templates/ # A directory of templates that, when combined with values," ... "will generate valid Kubernetes manifest files".

Charts page (v3): "name: The name of the chart (required)"; "version: The version of the chart (required)"; "appVersion: The version of the app that this contains (optional). Needn't be SemVer. Quotes recommended."; "This field is informational, and has no impact on chart version calculations."

Chart.yaml: name: web, version: 0.1.0, appVersion: "2.10.0"; comment: "appVersion only says which Caddy the default values run." templates/deployment.yaml and templates/service.yaml contain no .Chart.AppVersion (read in full; only .Release.Name and .Values.*). helm-template.txt lines 2-5 list the four chart files. Round 2: read from submodule working tree (git show not permitted).

Charts page (v3): "Helm Chart templates are written in the Go template language". Execution: values.yaml replicas: 1 / image.tag "2.10.0" render as "replicas: 1" and "image: \"caddy:2.10.0\"" (helm-template.txt lines 14, 25); --set image.tag=2.10.2 changes only the tag (line 35).

Built-in Objects (v3): Release.Name: "The release name". helm template usage: "helm template [NAME] [CHART] [flags]". Captured run of "helm template web deploy/helm/lessons/web ..." prints "name: web" and "app: web" (helm-template.txt lines 8, 12, 17, 21).

Values Files (v3): "values.yaml is the default, which can be overridden by a parent chart's values.yaml, which can in turn be overridden by a user-supplied values file, which can in turn be overridden by --set parameters." Using Helm (v3): "If both are used, --set values are merged into --values with higher precedence." -f overriding only its keys: helm-template.txt lines 30-31 (replicas 3, tag stays 2.10.0).
values.yaml: "replicas: 1", "repository: caddy", "tag: \"2.10.0\""; web-three-replicas.yaml has one key: "replicas: 3". Confirmed also by helm-template.txt lines 38-41.

helm template (v3): "Render chart templates locally and display the output." "Any values that would normally be looked up or retrieved in-cluster will be faked locally." "none of the server-side testing of chart validity (e.g. whether an API is supported) is done." Round 2: lesson now says "needs no kubeconfig" (§4, §6, mermaid "not needed"), matching this and the KUBECONFIG=/nonexistent run.

scripts/k8s/helm-template.sh line 20: export KUBECONFIG=/nonexistent/kubeconfig, set -euo pipefail (line 4); the captured run outputs/stage-3/scripts/k8s/helm-template.txt completes all renders (lines 7-44). I could not re-run helm in this session; evidence is the committed capture.

helm-template.txt: defaults "replicas: 1" / "image: \"caddy:2.10.0\"" (lines 14, 25); -f "replicas: 3" / "caddy:2.10.0" (lines 30-31); plus --set "replicas: 5" / "caddy:2.10.2" (lines 34-35). Matches the lesson's output block.

Round 2: text now conditions on helm template ("with `helm template`, `--set` changes only that render"). helm-template.txt lines 37-41: values.yaml still "replicas: 1" / tag "2.10.0" after the -f and --set renders. Using Helm (v3) on --set persisted in a Secret applies to installs, which the lesson no longer contradicts.
helm-template.txt lines 43-44: "== --set replicas=two" followed by "  replicas: two"; script runs under set -euo pipefail, so a helm error would have stopped it before line 45 was printed.

Deployment API reference (refs mirror) lines 84-85: "replicas" type "integer" - "Number of desired pods. ... Defaults to 1." Round 2: claim, §5 and q5.c now say only that the API defines replicas as an integer, so "two" is not a valid value; no rejection behaviour is asserted in prose.

deployment.yaml lines 2-3: "The web Deployment of deploy/k8s/lessons/web-deployment.yaml with two placeholders"; line 8/13/17 {{ .Release.Name }}, line 10 replicas: {{ .Values.replicas }}, line 21 image: "{{ .Values.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.image.tag }}". deploy/k8s/lessons/web-deployment.yaml exists (image: caddy:2.10.0).

Images (refs) lines 146-152: "if you omit the imagePullPolicy field, and the tag for the container image ... isn't `:latest`, the imagePullPolicy is automatically set to IfNotPresent." Round 2: §6 and q1.b (en/vi) now say the kubelet pulls "if the node does not already have it"; caddy:2.10.0 has a non-latest tag and no imagePullPolicy.

helm template (v3): usage "helm template [NAME] [CHART] [flags]"; -f, --values: "specify values in a YAML file or a URL (can specify multiple)"; -s, --show-only: "only show manifests rendered from the given templates".

Not re-run here. Follows from the captured run: same command form "helm template web deploy/helm/lessons/web --show-only templates/deployment.yaml" gives "replicas: 1" (helm-template.txt lines 8, 14), and --set image.tag=2.10.2 gives "caddy:2.10.2" (line 35); values.yaml unchanged afterwards (lines 37-41), so git status shows no change under deploy/helm on a clean checkout.
STAGE.md line 78: "Helm 3.19 (`helm-template.sh`, `helm-release.sh`, `traefik-install.sh`, ..."; helm-template.sh line 3: "Runs on the host, like every script in scripts/k8s/: helm runs from here."

issues.text: Carried from round 1. The quoted script comment (helm-template.sh lines 37-38) says "a value that breaks the YAML is found only by rendering", but `replicas: two` is valid YAML; it violates the Deployment schema, not YAML syntax. Lesson prose is correct; the comment inside the excerpt is not. Already recorded in meta repo_changes_needed; the submodule still has the old comment.
